name: bambu-bridge
description: Read and write Bambu Studio profiles, projects, slicing jobs and LAN printer controls.

interface.shortDescription: Read/write Bambu Studio and LAN printers.
interface.longDescription: Discover printers, inspect and edit profiles and 3MF settings, slice projects, read telemetry, transfer files and execute authorized commands. Requires local Studio and compatible LAN firmware.
interface.defaultPrompt: Discover my Bambu printer and inspect its status and Studio settings.
